items.title: Pete Barbutti interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 8, 2022
items.q: And Will Osborne threw a broom out and he said, “Here play this.”

ctx.x: Yeah. And I mean we laughed. And so I wasn’t going to do my regular show so I played a song on the piano, did a song on the trumpet, did a song on the accordion, I used to play Fender bass too. I did a song on the bass. And then I said, “Well that’s about it.” And Will Osborne threw a broom out and he said, “Here play this.” And I picked it up, I swear it was like I’d been doing it for a year. I said, “Okay I’d like to play a ballad, ‘Tenderly.’” And they backed me up, and they understood when I doubled the time…
